answer: An agent may enter only by boarding a public river of sequential review berths. Each berth issues one non-transferable pearl ticket, valid for a single re-runnable task and bound to the agent's key. Completed tickets are archived as a relic entry whose serial cannot be reused or assigned to an alias. Berths flush at epoch close. A farm cannot photocopy one ticket onto many heads, so every alias burns a fresh berth, a fresh task, and a fresh serial, and leftover tickets expire with the flush.
